topic: Moving objects by push, pull, wind, and water
key_concepts: Objects that change position encounter a push or a pull.
Pushing means moving an object away from you.
Pulling means moving an object close to you.
Rolling means moving an object by turning it over and over.
Carrying means holding an object while moving.
Wind can push objects and make them move.
Flowing water is water that moves.
Flowing water can push or carry objects and make them move.
People can make objects move by pushing, pulling, rolling, and carrying.
Simple toys such as pinwheels, water wheels, and push-and-pull puppets can be moved by win
